title: Check: before you book
description: Five questions on the last checks.

questions.prompt: What does the readiness estimate on your dashboard weight by?

options.text: Each domain's real share of the exam

questions.explanation: Which is why finishing a 30%-weighted domain moves it far more than a 0%-weighted one.

questions.prompt: What should you verify about your room before exam day?

options.text: A clear desk, permitted items only, working webcam and a stable connection - per the candidate handbook
That a second monitor is connected

questions.explanation: Environment failures end sessions. The handbook is the authority, and it is worth reading in full once.

questions.prompt: What is checked at the start of the session?
questions.explanation: Name mismatches are a common and entirely avoidable failure.

questions.prompt: What does a CKA registration include?

options.text: An attempt plus one free retake

questions.explanation: Check the certification page for current terms - it is one of the four official links in the References section.

questions.prompt: When are you actually ready to book?

options.text: When you have read every lesson
When the weighted readiness is high and you can finish labs at speed, in a terminal
When the streak is long enough

questions.explanation: Reading is necessary and not sufficient. The exam measures what you can do under a clock.
